title: Saudi Arabia’s PIF seeks to sell 25% stake in Newcastle United
FOX, NBC, get two of ex-ESPN games at center of NFL media rights talks
article_text:
The NFL is indeed set for additional broadcast television inventory this coming season, with FOX and NBC receiving some of the ex-ESPN inventory that at one point was earmarked for YouTube.

The NFL awarded FOX and NBC one game each out of the four windows ESPN relinquished as part of its deal to acquire NFL Network, Sports Media Watch has learned. The league is also expected to convert one regionally distributed game each on FOX and CBS to a national window.

The end result will be four additional national windows on broadcast television using a mix of new and existing inventory.

The league had been expected to see a slight increase in broadcast television inventory this season, and the ex-ESPN windows will functionally shift cable-exclusive inventory to broadcast. (Officially, the four ex-ESPN windows contractually belonged to ABC and ESPN+ as part of overlapping “Monday Night Football” doubleheaders. But with ABC apparently set to simulcast ESPN games in those four weeks instead, the change amounts to dropping four ESPN-exclusive editions of “MNF.”)

Fox CEO Lachlan Murdoch said on an earnings call Monday that the company’s new windows would consist of a Week 10 International Series game from Munich, which would air in an early morning window as part of a FOX tripleheader — the first NFL tripleheader on a single broadcast network since 2016. The second would be a Saturday game in Week 15. It was not clear which game came out of the ex-ESPN inventory and which was elevated from the Fox regional slate.

NBC announced Monday that its additional inventory would be a Saturday game in Week 17 leading into its annual Peacock-exclusive game, giving the company three exclusive windows that week.

CBS announced later Monday that its additional game window will air on primetime on the Saturday of Week 15, creating a split-network doubleheader with Fox on December 19. That is likely to be the day on which the College Football Playoff schedules the bulk of its first round games.

The additional broadcast TV inventory comes as the NFL faces a federal investigation into its rights deals with streaming companies that has been cheerled — and potentially may have even been sparked — by Fox Corporation.

The four ex-ESPN windows were originally expected to form the bulk of a new five-game media rights package — also including the league’s new International Series game from Australia — that the league had been reportedly shopping throughout the offseason. At some point in the process, the NFL is said to have shifted from shopping a single five-game package to splitting that inventory between Netflix and Google-owned YouTube. John Ourand of Puck reported last week that YouTube was not interested in that arrangement, and the two games it would have received were instead shopped to broadcast television.

The other two games are expected to go to Netflix, which would presumably form a ‘five-game package’ featuring those two contests, the Australia game, and its existing Christmas Day inventory.

title: CAF and Tanzania Tourist Board Sign AFCON PAMOJA 2027 Sponsorship Deal
article_text:
Tanzania, November 25, 2026 - The Confederation of African Football (CAF) and the Tanzania Tourist Board (TTB) have concluded a strategic partnership that makes TTB an Official Sponsor of the TotalEnergies CAF Africa Cup of Nations PAMOJA 2027. The agreement gives Tanzania a global platform to promote tourism, investment and its destinations during the tournament.

Under the partnership, the Tanzania Tourist Board will use the tournament’s international reach to market Tanzania to football audiences across Africa and beyond. CAF said the deal would help the country attract visitors and investment while showcasing its tourism experiences to the world.

The agreement was concluded as Tanzania launched the CAF AFCON 2027 coordination office in Dar es Salaam. Tanzanian media reported that the occasion included the signing of an agreement covering advertising and promotional rights for the tournament.

TotalEnergies CAF AFCON PAMOJA 2027 will be jointly hosted by Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda from 19 June to 17 July 2027. It will be the first Africa Cup of Nations staged by three countries, with matches in Nairobi, Dar es Salaam, Arusha, Zanzibar, Kampala and Hoima.

Tanzania will host matches in Dar es Salaam, Arusha and Zanzibar, giving the country three of the six confirmed host cities. Kenya will stage matches in Nairobi, while Uganda will host fixtures in Kampala and Hoima.

The sponsorship adds to Tanzania’s commercial and promotional role in the tournament. It also comes after CAF named Coca-Cola an Official Competition Sponsor of the 2027 and 2028 Africa Cup of Nations tournaments.

CAF has positioned PAMOJA—Swahili for “together”—as the defining theme of the three-nation hosting arrangement. The confederation says the name reflects the shared spirit and historic partnership between Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda.

The Tanzania Tourist Board’s sponsorship is expected to support tourism promotion around match venues, fan activities and international media coverage during the month-long tournament. It also gives Tanzania a direct platform to market destinations such as Zanzibar, Arusha and Dar es Salaam to visiting teams, officials, supporters and broadcasters.

The partnership is the latest commercial development ahead of AFCON 2027. CAF and the Local Organising Committees of the three host countries previously held a commercial roadshow to attract sponsors and partnerships for the tournament.

Preparations will now shift towards venue readiness, tournament operations and commercial activation across the three host nations. The first AFCON PAMOJA 2027 match is scheduled for 19 June 2027, with the final set for 17 July 2027.

title: Kraft Heinz isn’t afraid to get cheesy with its NFL sponsorship
article_text:
The NFL has gotten a little bit cheesier this season—and fans can’t just blame the league’s scriptwriters.

Earlier this year, Kraft Heinz inked a five-year, global partnership with the league for brands in its portfolio including Kraft, Velveeta, Philadelphia, and Kraft Mac & Cheese. It’s the first time multiple Kraft Heinz brands have been involved in the same long-term partnership, according to Ryan Djabbarah, the company’s head of sports and entertainment marketing—and halfway through the season, his team is already seeing results.

Their strategy, Djabbarah told Marketing Brew, has been based largely on weaving Kraft Heinz brands into NFL fan experiences in ways that are whimsical and funny while also adding value—like their latest activation, which reimagines end-zone pylons as blocks of cheese for Thanksgiving weekend as part of a Velveeta product giveaway.

“We want to make sure that we’re thinking about our products in a way that engages fans…in ways that they didn’t expect before from our brands,” Djabbarah said. “It felt like we should have been doing this a long time ago, and now that we’re finally here, I’m hopeful you’ll see a lot more of these ideas…coming to the table.”

The activation, Djabbarah said, was an easy yes once the team spotted the opportunity.

“That’s been hiding in plain sight the whole time—these Velveeta blocks looking like a pylon,” he said. “It just was too obvious and too opportunistic for us not to lean into, and hopefully [we’ll] lean into it even longer-term after Thanksgiving as well.”

The pylons themselves won’t carry Velveeta branding, but in the modern sports marketing landscape, there’s hardly an asset that isn’t up for sale, and Djabbarah said Velveeta-branded pylons aren’t out of the realm of possibility.

“It’s not to say we won’t go after it…at a later date, but there’s so few brands that are able to affect the actual in-game…that we don’t have that aspiration just yet,” he told us.

It’s not the first time in the short history of Kraft Heinz’s partnership with the NFL that the company has touted its portfolio of cheese-centric brands, and it won’t be the last, Djabbarah said. Earlier this season, cheeseburger enthusiast and Kansas City Chiefs head coach Andy Reid teamed up with Kraft Singles for a giveaway campaign, and Djabbarah said the brand is cooking up another NFL campaign set to roll out next month.

Heinz Tomato Ketchup, long associated with football since its parent company’s name used to adorn Acrisure Stadium in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, has also been an early fixture of the partnership. The brand now sponsors Prime Video’s “Red Zone Moments” highlights, and it also showed up in a big way around this year’s NFL Draft in Pittsburgh with “Mr. 57,” its new program honoring the 57th pick.

Stunts like these seem to be paying off: During the week of that activation in April, Heinz dollar sales increased by 20% compared to the same week in 2025, Djabbarah told us.

“To see that kind of success in just our first bite at the apple was a lot of fun,” he said.

While revenue growth is a main goal of the partnership, Djabbarah said he and his team are also looking to drive brand love and preference, especially during key periods for the company when the NFL plays, like back-to-school season and the holidays.

With the Super Bowl coming on the heels of the holiday season, Kraft Heinz marketers are already thinking about how to bring their brands to that game, too. For Djabbarah, that doesn’t necessarily mean a traditional TV ad buy; instead, Kraft Heinz brands are more likely to show up through customer hospitality programs and retail activations, similarly to how his team has leveraged the official NFL sponsorship thus far.

“In the past, we’ve had to say ‘Big Game,’ or never really talk about tickets,” he said. “Now, we have an opportunity not only to use the logo in an authentic way that we’re seeing success already from, but also [to] bring some fun personalities into it as well.”

Lucozade signs Lionesses star Alessia Russo
article_text:
Lucozade has signed England and Arsenal striker Alessia Russo to a long-term partnership, adding one of women’s football’s biggest names to its athlete roster and building on 20 years of support for the Lionesses.

Russo joins after a standout year. She became the highest-scoring English player in UEFA Women’s Champions League history, was named England Women’s Player of the Year, finished in the top ten of the 2026 Women’s Ballon d’Or and was named in the FIFPRO Women’s World 11.

The deal was unveiled at ‘Her Game. Her Fuel.’, an event in Shoreditch where Russo was interviewed by Ian Wright in front of athletes, creators, fans and cultural voices.

Alessia Russo said, “Football has always been a massive part of my life. Growing up, my dad would take me to watch women’s games at Charlton, and I remember looking up to those players and dreaming of doing the same one day. To see how far the game has come is incredible. Women’s football is now about so much more than what happens on the pitch. It’s influencing fashion, culture and bringing communities together in ways I could never have imagined growing up. To be part of that journey, and now working with Lucozade, a brand that’s supported the Lionesses for so many years, is really special.”

Under the partnership, Russo will work closely with Lucozade Sport to understand her individual hydration and fuelling needs and to explore how a more personalised approach can support her preparation, performance and recovery. She will also feed into future product innovation across the range. The road to the 2027 Women’s World Cup in Brazil is a major focus, with England still chasing qualification through the play-offs.

Lucozade has backed the Lionesses since 2006 and is part of Suntory Beverage & Food GB&I, whose brands also include Ribena and Orangina.

Matt Riches, Head of Partnerships at Suntory Beverage & Food GB&I, said, “Sport is changing, and so are the ways people connect with it. Alessia represents a new generation of athletes whose influence extends far beyond the pitch, inspiring more young women and girls to engage with sport in their own way.“

“She’s not only one of the most exciting talents in world football, but someone who is helping shape the culture around women’s sport, and we’re incredibly proud to welcome her to the Lucozade family.“

title: WRU and LooseHeadz launch mental health programme
article_text:
The Welsh Rugby Union (WRU) and rugby mental health charity LooseHeadz have launched a three-year programme to build mental health support shaped by the clubs and communities of Welsh rugby.

The Community Mental Health Delivery Programme will create workshops and resources for players, coaches, volunteers, staff, referees, physios and everyone else who keeps a club running. Rather than importing an existing programme, LooseHeadz will spend time in Welsh clubs, using surveys and focus groups to understand what the community needs before designing content around Welsh rugby’s language, culture and values.

Four clubs will take part in an initial pilot to test workshops and resources before a wider rollout. The first stakeholder meeting takes place today at Principality Stadium. LooseHeadz will lead content and delivery. The WRU will support club engagement and research, with a staff lead from its Integrity Team, and a joint steering committee will meet quarterly.

Rob Shotton, Co-founder of LooseHeadz, said, “Rugby clubs in Wales are more than just clubs. They’re the heart of their communities. Working with the Welsh Rugby Union means a huge amount to me personally and to everyone at LooseHeadz. It’s a big moment for us and shows how far we’ve come since we started as a conversation in our rugby club in 2017.

“Having the backing of a governing body matters. It tells clubs that mental health is a priority for Welsh rugby, and it helps us reach the people who need it most. Together, we want to add a layer of support to those hubs, for everyone who’s part of them: players, coaches, volunteers, refs, physios and staff. That means coming to Wales to listen first, understanding what the community needs, and building something completely bespoke for the people of Wales. It’s for the Welsh rugby community, by the Welsh rugby community.”

LooseHeadz Co-Founder Rob Shotton was part of the 2025 NextGen cohort and appeared on The Game Plan podcast to discuss the motivation behind the rugby charity.

Geraint John, Community Director at the Welsh Rugby Union, said, “We want rugby to thrive right across all our communities. It’s not just about the physical aspect of the sport itself. It’s also about health, wellbeing and mental health. We have over 50,000 registered players, alongside thousands of coaches, referees, volunteers and family members supporting the game. We want our environments to be safe and welcoming places where people can go, have conversations and know they will be supported.“

“We haven’t got all the expertise and knowledge within a governing body to do that alone. Through this collaboration with LooseHeadz, we can bring together their expertise and our access to clubs to educate and support the people who make up Welsh rugby.”

Former Wales international and British & Irish Lion Shane Williams has also backed the programme, drawing on his own difficulties adjusting to life after professional rugby.

LooseHeadz aims to place a Mental Health Champion at every rugby club in the world. It is supported by more than 50 ambassadors and is a charity partner of The British & Irish Lions Trust.

title: Everton signs NOCO in multi-year deal
article_text:
Everton have signed US power technology brand NOCO as battery charging partner in a multi-year agreement, adding a new commercial category to the club’s growing roster of international partners.

The deal gives NOCO LED perimeter advertising at Hill Dickinson Stadium and exposure across the club’s digital and social channels. It also gives the brand opportunities to host international clients and business guests at Everton fixtures. NOCO’s branding makes its debut at Everton’s next home game, the Merseyside derby.

Founded in Cleveland, Ohio, in 1914, the family-owned company specialises in battery chargers, portable jump starters, tyre inflators, lithium batteries and accessories, with operations across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. Its international expansion includes a recent agreement with Japanese automotive retailer AUTOBACS Global.

NOCO joins an Everton partner portfolio that includes Pepsi, Budweiser, Castore, Red Bull, Heinz, Nestlé, JYSK and Christopher Ward.

Mark Rollings, Chief Partnerships Officer at Everton, said, “We are delighted to welcome NOCO to Everton. NOCO is a well-established and respected international business with a proud heritage, a strong reputation for innovation and clear ambitions for continued global growth.“

“Securing a brand of NOCO’s standing in a new commercial category is another positive step in the development of our partnership portfolio. It also demonstrates Everton’s growing profile and the opportunities we can offer international businesses looking to build their brand through the global reach of the Premier League. NOCO joins an impressive group of globally recognised businesses already working with Everton, and we look forward to building a successful relationship that supports its continued growth.”

Zachary Koehler, Partnership Marketing Manager at NOCO, said, “We’re proud to partner with Everton, a club with a rich history and one of the most passionate fanbases in world football. Like Everton, NOCO is built on more than a century of heritage and a drive to keep moving forward.“

“As we continue to grow internationally, the global reach of the Premier League gives us a powerful platform to connect with new audiences, customers, and partners. We can’t think of a better way to make our debut than the Merseyside derby, and we look forward to a successful partnership with everyone at Everton.”

title: Formulate XP hires F1 sponsorship veteran Dan Staples as Founding Partner - Sector
article_text:
Formulate XP has appointed Dan Staples as Founding Partner and Managing Director.

Bringing nearly two decades of experience in sports sponsorship, he will shape the agency’s strategy and growth alongside Founder and Chief Executive Officer Ben McMahon.

The hire marks the senior-led sports marketing agency’s move from launch into delivery for the 2027 season, following the announcement of its five Driving Partners in October.

Staples will lead its client work and the senior team that owns the strategy, client relationships and delivery oversight for every programme.

He has worked on some of Formula 1’s biggest brand partnerships, including Santander’s programmes with Scuderia Ferrari and F1, and Petronas’ title partnership with the Mercedes-AMG PETRONAS F1 Team.

Staples was also involved in Tata Communications’ F1 Innovation Prize, which crowdsourced ideas from fans and saw the winning one taken into incubation by F1, a world first for global sport.

“Too often, agencies are brought in downstream to activate an idea someone else has already had,” Staples said.

“The best agency partnerships start earlier than that, with the strategy and the creative thinking, and they’re held to account for what they deliver.

“Formulate XP is built to work that way: one senior team that owns the thinking from the start.

“That’s why I wanted to build it with Ben, and I can’t wait to get started with our clients and Driving Partners.”

Formulate XP delivers commercial and partnership strategy, data-led audience intelligence, PR and communications, corporate hospitality and events production, and content and amplification for brands and rightsholders.

“Dan has built some of the most distinctive brand partnerships in Formula 1, and he’s done it by thinking first and activating second,” McMahon said.

“That’s exactly the approach Formulate XP was founded on. Having Dan as a Founding Partner gives us the senior leadership to scale the agency and the work we do for our clients.”

title: Australian soccer platform Football360 picks up Liga Portugal rights
article_text:
Football360, the nascent digital soccer content platform in Australia, has secured exclusive domestic broadcast rights to Portuguese soccer’s top-flight Liga Portugal for the remainder of the 2026-27 season.

The platform will stream two matches every week from the league with English commentary.

Combine business intelligence and editorial excellence to reach engaged professionals across 36 leading media platforms.

All selected matches will be streamed through the Football360 website at football360.com.au/watch.

Football360 will additionally offer full match replays on demand, mini matches, highlights, and short-form video content across its website and social media channels.

The streamer’s selection of fixtures will prioritise matches involving Australian internationals Nestory Irankunda (Sporting CP) and Alessandro Circati (Benfica), who both moved to Portugal this year.

The broadcast schedule will be announced by Football360 ahead of each matchweek. Coverage will begin with FC Porto’s clash against Sporting on Sunday (Monday in Australia due to the time difference).

Access to live broadcasts, full-match replays, mini matches, and highlights will be included as part of a Football360 Membership, priced at A$6.99 a month. Viewers who only want to access Liga Portugal can do so with a Portugal Pass.

Football360's broadcast agreement only covers selected league matches; it does not include the Portuguese Cup, which is shown by Australian public-service broadcaster SBS.

Live English-language coverage of Liga Portugal in Australia was previously not available for the 2026-27 season.

The deal marks Football360’s first major broadcast deal since launching in October 2025.

Football360 co-founder David Weiner said: “The mission of Antony Pinshaw and I since we took on this project is to not only take coverage of soccer in Australia to another level of commitment, consistency, and quality, but to make it easier and more enjoyable to be a soccer fan in Australia.

“At the same time, we also know that soccer is hard to follow and keep up with in 2026. Making it easier to follow was also one of the key reasons we launched and why we committed to building a business where editorial content remained free.

“Adding a broadcast layer obviously means we are adding another streaming decision for fans in Australia to make. We are conscious of that. There are already enough platforms to figure out – and it isn’t cheap.

“That is why we launched our Football360 Membership. With access to these games, we want to give fans a bit of respite and have teamed up with some great launch partners to give our members access to discounts and opportunities across the soccer ecosystem, from other streaming services to A-League tickets, merchandise and medical, with more to come.”

title: ABN AMRO Returns as Ajax Main Sponsor in Landmark Five-Year Partnership
article_text:
ABN AMRO will return as the main sponsor for Dutch football club Ajax starting July 1, 2027, marking a significant shift in the club's commercial strategy. For fintech professionals, this five-year deal illustrates the enduring value of sports sponsorship for established financial institutions looking to deepen brand loyalty and community engagement through high-profile cultural partnerships.

The agreement establishes ABN AMRO as the primary shirt sponsor for Ajax Men, Ajax Women, and the Ajax U23 squad. The five-year contract is set to commence on July 1, 2027, and will run through the conclusion of the 2031/2032 season. This transition follows the announcement that the club’s current sponsor, Ziggo, will end its 12.5-year partnership at the close of the 2026/2027 campaign.

The move represents a homecoming for the bank, which previously served as the club's main sponsor between 1991 and 2008. Even after that period, the bank maintained a presence as the main sponsor of the Ajax academy and the women’s team. It has also functioned as a community partner, supporting the Ajax Foundation and the shirt sponsor of the Only Friends Ajax teams. The selection of ABN AMRO followed what the club described as an intensive and carefully considered process aimed at balancing commercial value with a natural brand fit. This expanded role will see the bank move from a segmented sponsorship of the women's and youth teams back to the most prominent position across the entire club infrastructure.

"We are proud that ABN AMRO will once again feature on the Ajax shirt as the club's main sponsor, for both the men's and women's teams. Together, we have celebrated major successes and have shared a strong bond for 35 years. That rich history provides the foundation for a new beginning."

ABN AMRO Bank N.V. is a prominent Dutch financial institution headquartered in Amsterdam, serving retail, private, and corporate banking clients. The bank has undergone significant structural changes over the decades but remains a cornerstone of the Netherlands' financial sector, focusing on its core domestic market while maintaining specialized international operations. Its digital strategy has recently focused on modernizing IT infrastructure and integrating advanced technologies like generative AI to streamline operations.

Ajax, formally known as AFC Ajax, is the most successful football club in the Netherlands and one of the most recognized sporting brands globally. Based at the Johan Cruyff Arena in Amsterdam, the club is renowned for its youth academy and its "Total Football" philosophy. Commercially, Ajax operates as a publicly traded entity, making its sponsorship deals critical components of its annual revenue streams. The relationship between these two Amsterdam-based institutions spans nearly 35 years, making it one of the most enduring partnerships in European sports, surviving various economic cycles and shifts in the bank's corporate strategy.

FF News has tracked ABN AMRO’s recent efforts to modernize its technological and operational capabilities. In September 2026, the publication reported on how Infosys and ABN AMRO Extend Partnership to Scale Agentic AI and Modernize Banking IT, a move designed to simplify the bank's IT landscape. Additionally, the bank’s clearing division has been active in expanding market reach; FF News covered how ABN AMRO Clearing Expands 24x5 U.S. Equities Access via Bruce Markets Integration. This expansion provided clients with 24x5 access to U.S. equities, highlighting the bank's focus on enhancing its service offering for institutional and professional traders. These developments underscore a broader corporate strategy of balancing traditional brand presence with aggressive digital and service-level modernization.

This announcement signals a return to legacy branding in sports sponsorship, moving away from the trend of newer fintechs and crypto exchanges dominating shirt real estate. By securing a five-year commitment starting in 2027, Ajax gains long-term financial stability from a deeply integrated partner, while ABN AMRO reclaims a high-visibility asset that resonates with its core Dutch demographic. The move puts pressure on other traditional European banks to justify their marketing spend in an increasingly fragmented media landscape. It raises questions about whether such massive, multi-year outlays on traditional sports sponsorship can still deliver the same ROI as targeted digital acquisition in the modern banking era.

ABN AMRO will become Ajax's new main sponsor. Effective from July 1, 2027, the ABN AMRO logo will feature on the match shirts of Ajax Men, Ajax Women and Ajax U23. The agreement has a term of five years, running until the end of the 2031/2032 season. Last summer, Ajax announced that Ziggo would conclude its 12,5-year tenure as the club's main sponsor at the end of the 2026/2027 season.

Ajax and ABN AMRO share a long and successful history. The current main sponsor of Ajax Women has been associated with Ajax in various capacities for almost 35 years. Between 1991 and 2008, ABN AMRO served as the club's main sponsor. In the years that followed, the partnership included the main sponsorship of the Ajax academy and the women's team. The bank has also been the club's community partner for many years, a loyal supporter of the Ajax Foundation and the shirt sponsor of the Only Friends Ajax teams.

Menno Geelen, CEO of Ajax: "This is excellent news for the club. We are delighted that, following an intensive and carefully considered process, we have secured a new main sponsor in ABN AMRO. Our organisations have been connected for decades, and this main sponsorship will feel familiar to everyone within the club and to our supporters. We are grateful to ABN AMRO for the confidence in our future."

title: News: NHL media rights, Paramount-WBD, Angels and more
article_text:
The NHL has reportedly approached ESPN and TNT Sports about media rights renewals; Paramount has updated aspects of its hostile tender offer for Warner Bros. Discovery; and in-market streaming of Los Angeles Angels broadcasts will take place through the MLB DTC platform. Plus news on ESPN, Netflix, CBS-UFC and Fubo.

NHL commissioner Gary Bettman is said to have approached ESPN and TNT Sports about expediting their media rights negotiations, according to John Ourand of Puck Tuesday night. Ourand, who reported the same about the PGA Tour, wrote that the networks do not appear poised to negotiate new deals “until they know how much the NFL will ask for.” The NFL currently receives a reported sum of more than $11 billion annually for its media rights.

The NHL’s U.S. media rights deals, which are reportedly worth a combined $625 million, are not due to expire until after the 2028 season. But with the NFL widely expected to move up its media rights negotiations, leagues are reportedly looking to rush to the negotiating table while the networks still have money to spend.

TNT Sports lost its domestic NBA media rights package last year, but has in recent years acquired French Open tennis, NASCAR and — via sublicense — College Football Playoff games, among other properties. ESPN has committed billions in new rights and renewals since reacquiring NHL rights in March 2021 after a 17-year hiatus.

The NHL last year signed a 12-year media rights extension with Rogers Communications in Canada worth $11 billion CDN, but it does not begin until the 2026-27 season. Between the United States and Canada, the league will bring in reported media revenue of more than $1.2 billion USD per year for the two seasons those deals overlap.

Paramount on Tuesday updated its hostile tender offer for all of Warner Bros. Discovery to cover the $2.8 billion termination fee WBD would need to pay to get out of its commitment with Netflix, and add a $0.25/share “ticking fee” to WBD shareholders for every quarter the deal is not closed. The latter equates to approximately $650 million in cash value that would be distributed among WBD shareholders per quarter. Paramount again expressed confidence in quickly receiving the necessary regulatory approvals for the proposed transaction, which the company first initiated with a series of unsolicited bids starting last fall.

Paramount had previously sweetened its deal by raising the reverse termination fee to $5.8 billion, which is equivalent to the Netflix figure. Either of these suitors would need to compensate WBD with this fee if their pact does not receive regulatory approval. In its “enhanced” tender offer, Paramount claimed it would “fully reimburse” WBD for the potential $1.5 billion cost affiliated with not completing debt refinancing. The company said this payment would not reduce the reverse termination fee.

Paramount, which extended the expiration date for its offer by 10 days to March 2, has secured $43.6 billion in equity commitments coming from both the Ellison family and RedBird Capital Partners, including an “irrevocable personal guarantee” from Larry Ellison. Paramount also has $54 billion in debt commitments from Apollo, Bank of America and Citigroup. Moreover, Paramount said its financing sources would extend the maturity on a $15 billion bridge loan or that the company would “permit WBD to structure permanent financing in any way it chooses so long as the debt is redeemable at a commercially reasonable cost.”

Paramount has continued to argue that its bid is “superior” to the Netflix agreement, claiming the latter is operating off a sliding scale based on the amount of debt to be carried by Discovery Global. WBD disclosed that Discovery Global would carry $17 billion of debt “as of June 30, 2026” with a goal to reduce that number to $16.1 billion by year’s end. Since WBD is able to determine the amount of debt Discovery will hold prior to pro rata common stock distribution, a “debt adjustment mechanism” in the Netflix deal could potentially reduce its value. WBD confirmed receipt of Paramount’s offer, which its board will review.

The Los Angeles Angels on Tuesday joined the list of 21 Major League Baseball teams whose games will be distributed digitally via the league’s in-house direct-to-consumer platform, but it remains to be seen whether the team’s games will be produced by the league. The Angels are co-owners of the FanDuel Sports Network West RSN and are “contemplating buying out Main Street to launch their own network,” per a report by Mike Mazzeo of Sports Business Journal. Mazzeo cited sources who explained that the team has not ruled out launching a linear network this season or in the future, which could also include Los Angeles Kings NHL games.

While the majority of teams are working with MLB on the distribution of their games, not all of them are utilizing the league for production. At the moment, MLB is slated to produce live game broadcasts for the five teams it worked with last season (Diamondbacks, Guardians, Rockies, Twins, Padres) in addition to eight teams previously part of the Main Street Sports Group portfolio (Reds, Tigers, Royals, Marlins, Brewers, Cardinals, Rays, Nationals). The Seattle Mariners organization is also working with the league on production and distribution of local games after shutting down ROOT Sports Northwest last year.

For the 14 teams whose games are being both produced and distributed by MLB, the in-market streaming price is $20/month and $100 for the season. While the Angels have not announced their production arrangements for the upcoming season, the pricing is the same. MLB is also distributing local games televised on RSNs for six teams this season as well (Athletics, Orioles, Dodgers, Mets, Phillies, Giants). The pricing for these packages differs by market, and some of the solutions also include access to other programming from the applicable RSN.

title: WSL makes agreement with clubs to avoid gambling sponsors
article_text:
WSL Football, the organisation responsible for operating the top two tiers of women's football in the UK, has reached an agreement in principle for its clubs not to make sponsorship deals with betting companies.

Instead, the organisation has agreed to pursue sponsorship deals with brands from different industries, reports The Athletic. The outlet states that six additional sponsorship opportunities were made available ahead of the 2024/25 season, and these were filled by Apple, Airbnb, British Gas, Mercedes, Tesco and WTW.

While the agreement applies to WSL Football's own commercial partnerships, it does not stop individual WSL or WSL2 clubs from signing sponsorship deals with gambling companies.

Rather, it sets a different direction for WSL Football's league-level partnerships, giving the leagues the chance to shape their own commercial future. The organisation wants to continue aiding the growth of the women's domestic game, while combating issues such as player welfare, gambling-related online abuse and fluctuating attendances.

The changes also come at a time when English football is starting to take a wider look at gambling and related sponsorships. At the start of this season, the Premier League's voluntary ban on betting sponsors appearing on the front of match-day shirts came into effect, while the Premier League, EFL, FA and WSL also introduced a Code of Conduct for gambling-related sponsorship agreements in 2024.

Nevertheless, betting companies still feature prominently among sponsors at clubs throughout the top divisions in the men's game, with Betway signing a deal with Manchester United and clubs such as Leeds and Nottingham Forest also agreeing new deals over the summer.

title: HSBC Golf League returns for season 5 with expanded 18-event schedule
article_text:
HSBC India has launched Season 5 of the HSBC Golf League at the Bombay Presidency Golf Club in Mumbai, presenting its most ambitious schedule to date: 18 events spanning 15 cities, an increase from 13 events in 11 cities last season. No matter where they begin, participants can anticipate an enhanced tournament journey from the initial event to the final one.

Former Indian cricketer Harbhajan Singh, 11-time Asian Tour champion Gaganjeet Bhullar, Asian Games gold medalist Pranavi Urs, and Jaswinder Sodhi, Head of Customers, Digital & Marketing, International Wealth and Premier Banking at HSBC India, launched Season 5 of the HSBC Golf League. Each round of Season 5 leads up to the largest finale in the league’s history, and the prize at the conclusion is something most golfers can only imagine. The victors will journey to Scotland for a unique experience of HSBC hospitality at The 155th Open, which comes back to St Andrews, the birthplace of golf, from 11 to 18 July 2027. The tournament commemorates the centennial of Bobby Jones’ victory at The Open on the Old Course in 1927.

“Sport has the power to inspire, unite and create opportunities. By combining our international scale with the passion of our customers, we aim to support the growth of golf, nurture young talent through grassroots initiatives and bring the excitement to wider audiences in India and beyond. Our ambition is to bring golf to more people across the world and to promote the game at all levels by inspiring future generations to take part in the sport. In Season 5, the HSBC Golf League will travel to more cities than ever before, culminating in a journey to the home of golf. We look forward to welcoming our customers to the fairways and celebrating our winners at St Andrews next July,” said Jaswinder Sodhi, Head of Customers, Digital & Marketing, International Wealth and Premier Banking, HSBC India.

Season 5 will utilise a stroke play format, with handicaps determined through the Single Peoria method. All 18 competitions will be evaluated on The Golf League, the golfing platform created by Thriwe for HSBC India.

Through one app, players can explore forthcoming events, sign up for tournaments, monitor scores in real-time, manage their gameplay throughout the season, and engage with other golfers. The application is available throughout the year: qualified HSBC clients can schedule rounds at affiliated courses in India and abroad, and organise golf lessons and coaching sessions. Based on their advantages and the program, they may also take pleasure in guest privileges, golf cart services, and access to driving ranges.

title: Weightlifting and Wrestling Sign Sponsorship Deals Worth Up to 1.4 Billion Won Over Three Years with IBK
article_text:
The Korean Weightlifting Federation and the Korea Wrestling Federation have signed official sponsorship agreements with IBK Industrial Bank of Korea.

Yesterday, on November 24, the two federations signed agreements at the IBK headquarters in Euljiro, Seoul, securing up to 1.4 billion won in financial support over the next three years.

This agreement continues the sponsorship that began with their initial partnership in 2022. The funds will be used for domestic and overseas training camps for national team athletes ahead of major international events including the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics, as well as for improving training environments, fostering promising young athletes, and promoting grassroots sports.

Choi Sung-yong, president of the Korean Weightlifting Federation, expressed gratitude for the bank's continued support, stating that they will do their utmost to help athletes make a greater leap forward and achieve valuable results ahead of the LA Olympics.

Chang Min-young, president of IBK, stated that the bank will lend its support so that athletes can fully showcase their skills and future prospects can nurture their dreams.

title: NFL reportedly wants Paramount to increase rights fee north of 50-60 percent
article_text:
The incumbent NFL broadcasters may end up paying at least 50 percent more — amounting to in excess of $3.0 billion a year each — simply to keep their rights through the end of the originally negotiated terms.

The NFL is seeking a rights fee increase north of 50-60 percent as part of its media rights negotiations with CBS parent company Paramount Skydance, with that range representing the “midpoint” between what the league is seeking and what it is currently being offered, according to Alex Sherman of CNBC. A 50 percent increase would raise the current CBS rights fee of $2.1 billion/year past the $3 billion mark.

As John Ourand of Puck reported last week, the new rights fees will kick in immediately upon the completion of any deal. The league is expected to negotiate its renewals one-by-one, starting with Paramount and then Fox, per Ourand.

The new report Friday was the first concrete indication of where the NFL might set the market for its expedited media rights negotiations. A 50 percent increase across the board would take each of the league’s broadcast network rights deals past the $3 billion mark, with Disney paying more than $4 billion. But Amazon, which is paying just $1.0 billion/year for its main “Thursday Night Football” package, would still be paying less than $2 billion.

There is no reason to believe the NFL would seek consistent increases across the board, as it has not done so in past negotiations. In the 2011 media rights talks, Disney agreed to pay nearly twice as much for NFL rights ($1.9B/year) as any of the other networks (FOX was second-highest a $1.1B/year). When those rights were renewed in 2021, CBS, NBC and FOX saw their rights fees double, while Disney — which remained the highest-paying rightsholder — came away with a comparably modest 40 percent increase. One can envision a repeat in the upcoming negotiations, as it is hard to imagine that Prime Video will continue paying half as much as the other networks.

Notably, any eventual deal cannot be accurately described as a media rights ‘extension.’ Per Sherman, the NFL is agreeing only to waive the opt-out provision it could otherwise exercise in 2029. And while it has long been assumed that the NFL would exercise that opt-out, the fact is that those 2021 media rights deals were always set to run through the 2033-34 season. In agreeing to negotiate early, the networks are merely guaranteeing that they will have rights for as long as was originally negotiated.

title: Australian Sports Commission and Getty Images Launch Inclusive Community Sport Visual Library
article_text:
The Australian Sports Commission (ASC) has partnered with global visual content creator Getty Images to launch a dedicated visual library designed to modernise how grassroots sport is represented across Australia.

The collection is delivered under Play Well, Australia’s first national sport participation strategy, co-designed with the sector in 2023, and debuts with 250 authentic still images and videos spanning athletics, equestrian, netball, badminton, and football. By resolving a long-standing marketing bottleneck for national sporting organisations (NSOs) and local clubs, the initiative supplies sector-wide communications teams with representative promotional assets ahead of the Brisbane 2032 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

ASC executive general manager of sport system impact and chair of the Play Well Leadership Group, Richard McInnes, highlighted the commercial and participation impact of equipping sports with authentic visual storytelling tools.

“Play Well is built on the belief that everyone has a place in sport.”

“We know the way sport is represented can influence whether people feel welcome and believe there is a place for them.

“This partnership will give sporting organisations access to authentic images, to use in promotional material and communication, that actually reflects the diversity of the people, communities and experiences that make Australian sport so special.

“It is another practical step towards breaking down barriers to participation and ensuring more people can see themselves being involved in sport,” McInnes said.

Getty Images senior director of custom and creative partnerships, Svetlana Zhukova, emphasised the role of representative media in reshaping community perceptions ahead of Brisbane 2032.

“Sport has an extraordinary ability to connect people, but the images used to represent it don’t always reflect who is actually taking part.”

“Through the partnership, we’re giving sports organisations, media and communities access to imagery that better reflects the diversity of Australian sport as the country looks towards Brisbane 2032,” Zhukova said.

Produced in collaboration with community clubs and inclusion bodies—including Sport Inclusion Australia, Metropolitan Districts Netball Association, Footscray Rangers Football Club, and Melbourne Smashers Badminton, the library reflects diverse ages, cultural backgrounds, genders, and physical abilities. Sporting bodies and sector partners can request direct access to the asset bank via the ASC marketing team, with additional sports scheduled for production and integration throughout 2027.

title: World Rugby Appoints Heinz as Official Condiment Supplier for Rugby World Cups 2027 and 2029
article_text:
World Rugby has appointed food manufacturer Heinz as Official Condiment Supplier across both the Men’s Rugby World Cup 2027 and Women’s Rugby World Cup 2029 in Australia.

The multi-tournament agreement integrates Heinz’s core table sauce portfolio, including Heinz Ketchup and Mayonnaise, into stadium foodservice operations and official Fan Festivals across all seven Australian host cities.

The partnership expands World Rugby’s fast-moving consumer goods roster for its consecutive Australian tournament cycle, joining Principal Partners Asahi, Emirates, and Visa alongside fellow Official Suppliers and Supporters including Gilbert, Macron, Ticketmaster, Unilever, and Woolworths.

Men’s Rugby World Cup managing director, Chris Stanley, highlighted the value of partnering with a household food manufacturer ahead of the largest men’s tournament to date.

“We are thrilled to welcome Heinz, a historic and treasured brand, as an Official Supplier for Men’s Rugby World Cup 2027 and Women’s Rugby World Cup 2029.”

“As rugby continues to grow its international footprint, it’s an exciting opportunity to partner with a renowned food manufacturer and supplier like Heinz, who will help us deliver both tournaments and create more pathways to grow the sport in Australia and worldwide.

“Heinz has a longstanding legacy of serving up much loved sauces and condiments to families and households across the globe, so we are delighted to have the company on board as we get set to deliver two iconic Rugby World Cups.

“With less than one year to go until next year’s tournament, it’s an exciting time to join the partner family as we prepare to host the biggest edition of Men’s Rugby World Cup to date,” Stanley said.

Heinz ANZ chief marketing officer, Michael Magee, emphasised the natural alignment between match-day hospitality and the brand’s multi-generational Australian heritage.

“Sport has an incredible ability to bring people together, and food has always been part of how fans experience those big game day moments.”

“As a brand that has been part of Australian mealtimes for generations, we’re incredibly proud to partner with Men’s Rugby World Cup 2027 and Women’s Rugby World Cup 2029 – particularly on home soil. From the pre-match build-up to the final whistle, we’ll be there to bring the flavour and make every win taste even better,” Magee said.

Landing with less than 12 months remaining before the expanded 24-team Men’s Rugby World Cup kicks off across six weeks from 1 October to 13 November 2027, the agreement capitalises on strong early commercial demand, with more than 1.3 million tickets already sold.

Dual-Tournament Official Supplier Rights: Grants Heinz category exclusivity as Official Condiment Supplier for both Men’s Rugby World Cup 2027 and Women’s Rugby World Cup 2029.

Seven-City Venue & Fan Festival Supply: Deploys Heinz Ketchup, Mayonnaise, and table sauces across all match venues and official Fan Festivals throughout Australia’s seven host cities.

Commercial Runway & Ticket Momentum: Anchors brand activation ahead of the 1 October – 13 November 2027 men’s tournament, which has already surpassed 1.3 million tickets sold across its 24-team format.
